::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** April 11 1868  
**Manuscript:** Copy outletter book British Library Add MSS.55388 (1): P.227
:::

Dear Miss Yonge,
I have sent on to [Miss Sewell](people/person_1301.qmd) Mr Pearson’s [book](other_books/otherbook_519.qmd). Could you tell [me](people/person_939.qmd) how much - how many pages - you want to use.[^1] I think I may have an opportunity of seeing him soon. He is not likely to refuse.

The story of the Hermits(?) is really wonderful. I cannot tell you how that of Anthony [*illegible*] me. What <u>moral pictures</u> there must have been there. 

I am urging the printers to make speed.

Yours very faithfully
A. Macmillan

---

[^1]: Pearson's book was excerpted in both *Historical Selections* and its continuation *European History*.
